item.title: Scaffolding a Modern Frontend with OpenCode and Next.js
item.description: You open a fresh Next.js project, cd into src/components, and the directory is empty. Not “empty like a new sketchbook” empty — empty like a blinking cursor daring you to type npx create-next-app for the fifth project this month and then rebuild the same dashboard shell you’ve built a dozen times before. You’ve got OpenCode running against a local Qwen3.5 9B model because the client’s compliance team won’t let code anywhere near a hosted API, and you’re about to find out the hard way that “build me a dashboard” is not a prompt — it’s a dare.
